checks_run: Read-only inventory, mode, special-file, hard-link, and credential-pattern inspection
Static review of requirements, learner material, reference code, tests, and validation claims
Configured Python, GCC, Arm GCC/binutils, QEMU, Make, and timeout identity checks
Environment audit unit tests and allowlisted-source audit
Reviewer-materialized strict learner-view audit plus negative extra-file and symlink checks
ASan/UBSan reference tests, adversarial vectors, and public tests against reference and starter
Clean Arm cross-builds, reproducible artifact hashes, readelf inspection, and undefined-symbol check
Bounded QEMU runs of the sealed reference and incomplete starter
Exercise syntax checks and diagnostic benchmark compilation
Pre/post aggregate hash check proving CANDIDATE was not changed
evidence: The candidate contains 101 regular files and 36 directories, with no symlinks, special objects, hard-link groups, credential-pattern matches, or setuid/setgid regular files.
MANIFEST.yaml remains GENERATED/PARTIAL, requires independent validation, sets productionized=false, and agrees with PROVENANCE.json on project, source, commit, and snapshot identifiers.

Five learner-view audit unit tests passed; source mode and a reviewer-created strict view both reported 55 entries, 43 regular files, 12 directories, and inventory SHA-256 d1879d8df860f1b346cd3ddfb9d0bdfe8c74bc9e2d52447995b1bdfc858abdfc.
Strict learner-view mode independently rejected an extra root entry and an in-tree symlink with exit 1.

With GCC 15.2.0 and ASan/UBSan, sealed reference tests passed 407 checks, adversarial execution passed 12 vectors, public tests passed against the reference, and a reviewer-authored harness passed 86 additional checks.
The untouched starter independently reproduced the documented 37 public-test failures and exit 2; it is visibly incomplete rather than a disguised solution.
Fresh Arm GCC 15.2.1 builds of reference and starter exited 0, and all four ELF/bin SHA-256 values exactly matched the submitted validation record.
The reference ELF is ELF32 little-endian Arm EABI5 with entry 0x10000, separate RX/RW load segments, an RW non-executable GNU stack, and no undefined symbols.

QEMU 9.1.1 ran the reference to exit 0 with LF-KERNEL boot, mmu: on, vm: ok, ramfs: ok, tasks: ABABAB, and PASS reference in order; the starter produced no marker and timed out at two seconds with exit 124.
The aggregate submitted-file hash was db46cb9476c1a7960f53a1df35014ad19293f9d360737a40541edb052e2bded9 both before and after review testing.
limitations: CANDIDATE lacks the external PRIOR_BUILD tree required by sealed/pack_audit.py. The submitted command exits 1 and its shared exception path also emits a spurious manifest-mismatch diagnostic, so prior-path preservation and the builder's reported pack-audit PASS are not independently reproducible here.
The strict learner policy omits LICENSE_BOUNDARY.md, so the materialized learner view does not carry the full pack's explicit all-rights-reserved and no-redistribution notice.
Debugging and review exercise prose describes post-attempt disclosure, but no deterministic staged-view policy or audited materializer is supplied for those roots.
adversarial/run_vectors.py uses argv, capture, and a timeout but does not launch and terminate a process group as required by the workspace subprocess invariant.
The immutable catalog baseline, upstream repository, network, and physical Arm hardware were unavailable; origin/no-copy assertions and physical-board behavior remain inconclusive.

No fuzz campaign, repeated benchmark, formal proof, security audit, transfer validation, or production workload was performed. Java, AArch64, Node, Go, NASM, Flex, and Bison were irrelevant and not invoked; rg and git were unavailable.
